description: This file defines the state and utility functions for managing a toolbar in a rich text editor built with Slate.js. It includes types for toolbar items, functions to derive toolbar state based on editor context, and utilities for navigating the editor's document structure.

classes.name: ToolbarState
classes.description: Represents the state of the toolbar, including selected and disabled states for various formatting options, and references to the editor and document features.

methods.name: getAncestorComponentChildFieldDocumentFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves document features for a child field of an ancestor component in the editor, based on the current selection.

methods.name: createToolbarState
methods.description: Generates the current toolbar state based on the editor's selection, document features, and component blocks.

methods.name: hasBlockThatClearsOnClearFormatting
methods.description: Checks if the current selection contains a block that should be cleared when clearing formatting.

methods.name: getListTypeAbove
methods.description: Determines the type of list (ordered, unordered, or none) above the current selection in the editor.
